themes_detail.label: SPIT Inspections Surge
themes_detail.summary: Special Projects Inspection Team (SPIT) complaints spiked to 5 this week versus a baseline of 0.4 per week over the prior 8 weeks—a 1233% increase (z-score: 9.55)—suggesting either a major building code violation discovery or enforcement crackdown in CD 205 this week.
evidence: 5 SPIT complaints this week vs. 0.4 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (1233% spike, z-score: 9.55)
Signal strength: z-score of 9.55 indicates extreme statistical anomaly
reporting_angles: What triggered SPIT deployment in CD 205 this week? Interview DOB and 311 coordinator.
Which building(s) or blocks are under inspection? Cross-reference permit filings (251 recent alterations on record).

themes_detail.label: Homeless Assistance Complaints Rise
themes_detail.summary: Homeless Person Assistance complaints doubled to 5 this week from a baseline of 2.2 per week (122% spike, z-score: 4.16), suggesting either a visible encampment emergence or service gap in CD 205.
evidence: 5 homeless assistance complaints this week vs. 2.2 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (122% spike, z-score: 4.16)
Suggests clustering in specific locations or visible encampments
reporting_angles: Map this week's complaints to identify hot-spot blocks (Fordham Road? University Ave?).
Interview residents and local merchants on whether visible homeless presence has visibly increased.

themes_detail.label: Illegal Tree Damage Spike
themes_detail.summary: Illegal Tree Damage complaints jumped to 3 two weeks ago from a baseline of 0.1 per week (2300% spike, z-score: 8.69), indicating either coordinated illegal tree removal or development-related vegetation destruction in the district.
evidence: 3 illegal tree damage complaints 2 weeks ago vs. 0.1 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (2300% spike, z-score: 8.69)
251 recent DOB permits filed (139 alterations, 69 new buildings, 10 demolitions) may correlate with tree removal
Signal emerges 2 weeks ago and may still be active
reporting_angles: Cross-reference illegal tree damage complaints with recent DOB permits to identify whether demolition/alteration work is illegally removing protected trees.
Interview NYC Parks on whether any developers or contractors have been flagged for unauthorized tree removal.

themes_detail.label: Water System Infrastructure Issues
themes_detail.summary: Water System complaints peaked 3 weeks ago at 26, representing a 215% spike from the 8-week baseline of 8.2 per week (z-score: 5.08), though current status is unclear; this may signal a resolved incident or ongoing subsurface infrastructure concern.
evidence: 26 water system complaints 3 weeks ago vs. 8.2 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (215% spike, z-score: 5.08)
Related: 606 water leak complaints and 988 plumbing complaints over 90-day period suggest broader water infrastructure stress
Timing: spike occurred 3 weeks ago; need to confirm if resolved or ongoing
reporting_angles: Did a water main break or DEP work occur 3 weeks ago? Verify current status with NYC DEP.
Interview residents in affected blocks on whether water pressure, discoloration, or service interruptions persist.

themes_detail.label: For-Hire Vehicle Complaint Surge
themes_detail.summary: For Hire Vehicle complaints surged to 8 two weeks ago from a baseline of 2.8 per week (191% spike, z-score: 3.55), suggesting either reckless Uber/Lyft activity or increased enforcement focus on gypsy cabs in the district.
evidence: 8 for-hire vehicle complaints 2 weeks ago vs. 2.8 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (191% spike, z-score: 3.55)
Related: 2352 illegal parking complaints over 90 days suggests traffic/vehicle enforcement is active
reporting_angles: What types of for-hire vehicle violations are clustered 2 weeks ago? (Unlicensed cabs? Dangerous driving? Double parking?)
Interview TLC or NYPD to learn whether enforcement operation or complaint trend is driving the spike.
